channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Larry Ellison | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Larry Ellison from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Joe Lacob on Larry Ellison
item.description:
On the advice of then-NBA Commissioner David Stern, he bought into his hometown Boston Celtics as a minority partner and built relationships with league honchos.

“When the Warriors came up in 2010, I had an advantage, ironically — maybe my only advantage — over Larry Ellison, which was I knew everybody in the league really well,”

Joe Lacob on Larry Ellison, Jul 11, 2022. Source: San Francisco Chronicle.

item.title: David Stern on Larry Ellison
item.description:
Stern, though famously powerful, saw himself as more of a facilitator in this and other proceedings.

“I knew that Sal was representing the product, and I knew Joe, and I knew Larry (Ellison) and so I was in touch with them,”

David Stern on Larry Ellison, Jul 24, 2018. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Michael Heisley on Larry Ellison
item.description:
“Mr. Ellison chose to go to the paper in San Jose, or one of his people did, which really did not please me too much.”

Michael Heisley on Larry Ellison, Jun 11, 2012. Source: NBA.com.
